local p = {}
local cargo = mw.ext.cargo

function p.Parse( frame )
    local str    = require( 'Module:String' )
    local output = frame.args[1]
    local paths  = {
      -- Input                              Replacement

      -- Generic
      { [[game]],                         [[<path-to-game>]] },
      { [[uid]],                          [[<user-id>]] },
      { [[steam]],                        [[<Steam-folder>]] },
      { [[steamlibrary]],                 [[<SteamLibrary-folder>]] },
      { [[uplay]],                        [[<Ubisoft-Connect-folder>]] },
      { [[ubisoftconnect]],               [[<Ubisoft-Connect-folder>]] },

      -- Windows > Registry
      { [[hkey_current_user]],            [[HKEY_CURRENT_USER]] },
      { [[hkcu]],                         [[HKEY_CURRENT_USER]] },
      { [[hkey_local_machine]],           [[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE]] },
      { [[hklm]],                         [[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE]] },
      { [[wow64]],                        [[Wow6432Node]] },

      -- Windows > Drive
      { [[username]],                     [[%USERNAME%]] },
      { [[userprofile\appdata\locallow]], [[%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow]] }, -- Needs to run before %USERPROFILE%
      { [[userprofile\documents]],        [[%USERPROFILE%\Documents]] },        -- Needs to run before %USERPROFILE%
      { [[userprofile]],                  [[%USERPROFILE%]] },
      { [[appdata]],                      [[%APPDATA%]] },
      { [[localappdata]],                 [[%LOCALAPPDATA%]] },
      { [[temp]],                         [[%TEMP%]] },
      { [[public]],                       [[%PUBLIC%]] },
      { [[allusersprofile]],              [[%PROGRAMDATA%]] },
      { [[programdata]],                  [[%PROGRAMDATA%]] },
      { [[programfiles]],                 [[%PROGRAMFILES%]] },
      { [[windir]],                       [[%WINDIR%]] },
      { [[syswow64]],                     [[SysWOW64]] },

      -- OS X
      { [[machome]],                      [[$HOME]] },
      { [[osxhome]],                      [[$HOME]] },

      -- Linux
      { [[linuxhome]],                    [[$HOME]] },
      { [[xdgdatahome]],                  [[$XDG_DATA_HOME]] },
      { [[xdgconfighome]],                [[$XDG_CONFIG_HOME]] },
    }

    -- We do not care about strip markers (<pre>, <nowiki>, <gallery> and <ref>)
    output = mw.text.killMarkers( output )
    
    -- Template:Path
    for key,values in pairs(paths) do
      --mw.log(key)       -- Index
      --mw.log(values[1]) -- Input
      --mw.log(values[2]) -- Replacement
      local expanded = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Path', args = { values[1] } }
      output = str.replace{ args={ output, expanded, values[2] } }
    end

    -- Template:LocalizedPath
    local wildcardPlaceholder = [[LPLPLP]]
    local tempLocalizedPath = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'LocalizedPath', args = { wildcardPlaceholder } }
    local tempLocalizedPath = str._escapePattern( tempLocalizedPath )
    local tempLocalizedPath = str.replace{ args={ tempLocalizedPath, wildcardPlaceholder, [[(.-)]] } }
    for value in mw.ustring.gmatch( output, tempLocalizedPath ) do
      --mw.log(value)
      output = mw.ustring.gsub( output, tempLocalizedPath, '<Localized ' .. value .. '>' )
    end

    -- Template:Code
    local wildcardPlaceholder = [[CCCCCC]]
    local patternTemplate = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Code', args = { wildcardPlaceholder } }
    local patternTemplate = str._escapePattern( patternTemplate )
    local patternTemplate = str.replace{ args={ patternTemplate, wildcardPlaceholder, [[(.-)]] } }
    for value in mw.ustring.gmatch( output, patternTemplate ) do
      --mw.log(value)
      output = mw.ustring.gsub( output, patternTemplate, value )
    end

    -- Return
    return output
end

function p.Store( frame )
    local table = 'GameData'
    local args = {
        ['Type']     = frame.args[1],
        ['Platform'] = frame.args[2],
        ['Paths']    = frame.args[3]
    }
    local result = cargo.store( table, args )
end

function p.Declare( frame )
    local args = {
      _table = 'GameData',
        ['Type']     = 'String',
        ['Platform'] = 'String',
        ['Paths']    = 'List (,) of String'
    }
    local result = cargo.declare( args )
end

return p
